rules.trigger: Potential irreversible loss of continued ability to act
rules.policy: Impose hard exposure constraints before comparing expected benefits

rules.trigger: New data might improve a pending decision
rules.policy: Collect data only when it might change action enough to justify cost and delay

rules.trigger: Other actors adapt and have evidenced differences in perceived game structure
rules.policy: Compare documented perceived action sets and payoffs instead of asserting hidden motives
